_about: Claude's drafts of rulers' lines, for Rich to review (D-62). Development builds show them beside rivalLines.json; release builds never do. To approve a line, move it into rivalLines.json under the same ruler and key (and edit it as you like). Patch 8's drafts were all approved and moved there on 2026-10-31 (D-67). Patch 10 stage 3's drafts (R5, D-91), written as parts (F3, D-79), were all approved and moved there on 2026-11-17 (D-92): a key holding { open, body, close } builds its line from one body, with an opening and a close when given, picked by the day; docs/redesign/patch-10-lines.md shows them with built lines. Patch 10 stage 4's drafts (L2, D-93), each ruler's `ranks`, one whole line for each rank of his path (1 to 5) spoken on the rank's card, were all approved and moved there on 2026-11-20 (D-94); docs/redesign/patch-10-rank-lines.md shows them.
